raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Anthropic clients send `tool_choice.disable_parallel_tool_use: true` to allow at most one tool call in a turn. The `/v1/messages` endpoint dropped this field, so parallel tool calls stayed on. A reviewer noted the missing field when the endpoint was added in #18630, and it was not followed up.

## Modifications

- Add the optional `disable_parallel_tool_use` field to `AnthropicToolChoice`.
- When it is true, the converter sets `parallel_tool_calls=False` on the chat completion request. The chat path already applies that setting to the tool call constraints.
- New unit test `test_tool_choice_disable_parallel_tool_use_is_forwarded`. Its `disable_parallel_tool_use=True` case fails on main and passes with this change. The whole `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/anthropic` folder passes: 64 passed.

## Accuracy Tests

Not affected. The change only converts the request.

Not affected.

files.patch:
@@ -252,6 +252,7 @@ class AnthropicToolChoice(BaseModel):
 
     type: Literal["auto", "any", "tool", "none"]
     name: Optional[str] = None
+    disable_parallel_tool_use: Optional[bool] = None
 
 
 class AnthropicThinkingParam(BaseModel):

@@ -1322,6 +1322,27 @@ def test_tool_choice_named_custom_tool_is_resolved(self):
         self.assertEqual(chat_request.tool_choice.type, "function")
         self.assertEqual(chat_request.tool_choice.function.name, "lookup")
 
+    def test_tool_choice_disable_parallel_tool_use_is_forwarded(self):
+        """tool_choice.disable_parallel_tool_use=true must not be dropped;
+        it turns off parallel tool calls, and false keeps them on."""
+        serving = self._serving()
+        tools = [
+            {
+                "type": "custom",
+                "name": "lookup",
+                "input_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {}},
+            }
+        ]
+        for disable, expected_parallel in ((True, False), (False, True)):
+            with self.subTest(disable_parallel_tool_use=disable):
+                request = self._anthropic_request(
+                    stream=False,
+                    tools=tools,
+                    tool_choice={"type": "any", "disable_parallel_tool_use": disable},
+                )
+                chat_request = serving._convert_to_chat_completion_request(request)
+                self.assertEqual(chat_request.parallel_tool_calls, expected_parallel)
+
     def test_tool_choice_named_unknown_tool_raises_400(self):
         """tool_choice={type:'tool', name:'X'} where X is missing must raise."""
         serving = self._serving()
